description: Access FPA Women's Health clinic location details including address, phone, hours, services, and coordinates from www.fpawomenshealth.com

function.description:
Function to call. Available values:
  - list_locations: Get all clinic locations (no additional params needed)
  - get_location: Get details for a specific location (requires location_id and slug)
  - search_locations: Search locations by name (requires query)
  - get_multiple_locations: Get details for multiple locations (requires locations list)

location_id.description: Numeric ID of the location (e.g., 13 for Fresno). Used with get_location.

slug.description: URL slug of the location (e.g., 'fresno'). Used with get_location.

query.description: Search query string for location name (case-insensitive partial match). Used with search_locations.

locations.description: List of location objects with 'id' and 'slug' keys. Used with get_multiple_locations.
